title: Perfect Stack
description: Test your reflexes and precision! Tap to drop traveling neon slabs, slice off misalignments, and trigger harmonic combo streaks as you construct the tallest tower in the cosmos.
instructions: A neon block slides continuously back and forth across the screen.
Click, press Space, or tap to drop the block onto the existing stack.
Any portion hanging off the edge will be sliced off!
Achieve consecutive perfect alignments to restore block width and activate mega combos.
controls: Mouse Click / Spacebar / Touch Tap: Drop block
